question: Which cost source should status use before merge: exact full transcript scans, bounded transcript data, or a maintained/precomputed session cost aggregate?
rationale: The user-visible feature is useful, but exact full-history cost and fast default status paths have different accuracy, storage, and availability tradeoffs that automation should not choose silently.

options.title: Use bounded or maintained cost data
options.body: Keep default status responsive by replacing full scans with a bounded read or a maintained aggregate before merge.

options.title: Accept exact full scans
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept full transcript scans for exact cumulative cost, but that owns the responsiveness tradeoff for long sessions.

options.title: Pause for aggregate design
options.body: Pause this PR if the right answer requires broader session aggregate storage work than this branch should own.

recommendation.title: Use bounded or maintained cost data
recommendation.body: Keep default status responsive by replacing full scans with a bounded read or a maintained aggregate before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The open choice centers on the transcript-reader seam and aggregate-vs-bounded read behavior that jalehman recently refactored.
